otito — layered diagram

Local-first repository intelligence: discover code, build context for agents, rank change impact, and gate merges on recomputable evidence — via CLI, MCP, or CI.

Entry surfaces Discover & index Context & maps Change impact Review & gates Evidence

Animated workflow

1
ConnectInstall the CLI or wire an MCP host · optional init scaffold for CI and hooks
2
DiscoverInspect repo shape · index a catalog · search paths and symbols
3
ContextGenerate maps, task packs, and harness commands before the agent edits
4
ImpactRank the files a change should touch · score how agent-friendly the repo is
5
Review & gateBuild PR context · score intent against the diff · run the merge gate
6
EvidenceArtifacts, recomputable receipts, PR comments, and a CI verdict

MCP server

stdio MCP server exposing 13 tools: repo_inspect, repo_map, repo_index, repo_search, context_pack, change_impact, agent_experience, convergence_score, review_gate, review_verdict, workspace_report, review_context, repo_harness. Published in the MCP Registry as io.github.BASHBOP/otito.
